page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The CPU includes hardware flags such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, and SHA_NI for cryptographic and vector processing.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates consistent mid-tier performance across compute and memory tasks. The stress-ng multi-core CPU test yielded a score of 30983.52, while the Geekbench multi-core score reached 13384.0. Memory bandwidth tests showed a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec and an uncached large block write speed of 65.94 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the server achieved a strong result in LLM text generation using a small 135M model at 282.15 tokens/sec, though its prompt processing speed for the same model remained in the average tier at 2011.18 tokens/sec. Redis SET operations reached 30.13 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput was measured at 28.84 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.r7.8xlarge is the complete absence of local NVMe storage, meaning all disk operations must traverse the network, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. Qualitatively, the instance offers a resource-dense memory profile suitable for memory-bound applications without the added cost of GPU accelerators. Given its high memory capacity and dedicated CPU allocation, this server is configured for database operations, memory-intensive caching layers, software compilation, and medium-scale text or image processing workloads.
